text_block_list.text:
On my way back, I saw some Umamusume
dancing on the riverbank.
As I watched them idly—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, choverigoo♪
Next, keep the stage dimensions in mind――oh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what a coincidence.
What's the matter? Why are you in such a rush?
choice_data_list: What about you? Why are you dancing by the riverbank?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Why? Because... maybe I felt like dancing?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look. The sunset is making the water sparkle so much,
I thought it looked just like penlights—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I just suddenly felt like practicing for the concert!
If there's any reason, that's really all it is.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I was surprised. We were just out on a walk together, and suddenly she said, 'I feel like dancing.'

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for dragging you along.
I didn't mean to jerk you around so much, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "A-OK☆ I'm with you because I want to be, after all."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I really like C.B.-chan's dancing, you know?
You can truly feel how much fun she's having.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you dance at the Winning Live,
you always have such a genuinely pure smile, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Yeah, maybe you're right.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Moving your body to the music is fun, isn't it?
If I had to give a reason why I dance at concerts,
that'd probably be it.
choice_data_list: I'm sure the fans are waiting for that version of you.
I'm sure the fans are waiting for you to be like that.
Then what if you don't feel like dancing at the live show?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Moving your body to the music is fun, isn't it?
If I had to give a reason why I dance at concerts,
that'd probably be it.
choice_data_list: I'm sure the fans are waiting for that version of you.
I'm sure the fans are waiting for you to be like that.
Then what if you don't feel like dancing at the live show?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh... A fan did?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly☆ There's something really alluring
about free dance that isn't bound by anything.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's any need for you to look back.
I'm sure the fans will follow right behind you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahaha! I see, then nothing changes
about what I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's continue with the lesson.
After all, we've got two audience members right here.

Afterward, I watched over her dance,
illuminated by the spotlight of the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mm, yeah, I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, you'll just have
to perform in the concert in my place.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're breaking out in a cold sweat.
I'm kidding, of course, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wanna cause trouble for the other girls.
Though I might ad-lib a bit of the choreography, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how wonderful! Dancing in the same
concert as CB-chan would be so exciting♪

Afterward, I stayed to watch her dance to her heart's content
until the sun finally sank below the horizon.
